heading.en: The Nephite armies defeat the Gadianton robbers—Giddianhi is slain, and his successor, Zemnarihah, is hanged—The Nephites praise the Lord for their victories. About A.D. 19–22.
heading.sm: Ua faatoilalo e autau a sa Nifaē le au faomea a Katianetona—Ua fasiotia Kitianae, ma lona sui, o Seminaraea, ua sisi—Ua viia e sa Nifaē le Alii mo lo latou manumalo. E tusa o le 19–22 T.A.

verses.en: And it came to pass that in the latter end of the eighteenth year those armies of robbers had prepared for battle, and began to come down and to sally forth from the hills, and out of the mountains, and the wilderness, and their strongholds, and their secret places, and began to take possession of the lands, both which were in the land south and which were in the land north, and began to take possession of all the  lands which had been deserted by the Nephites, and the cities which had been left desolate.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo i le taufaaiuiuga o le tausaga e sefulu ma le valu sa uma ona sauniuni autau a ia faomea mo le taua, ma amata ona latou o ifo ma feosofi faafuasei mai i maupuepue, ma i fafo mai o mauga, ma le vao, ma o latou liumalolosi, ma o latou nofoaga lilo, ma amata ona fai mo i latou laueleele, ia sa i le laueleele i saute ma ia sa i le laueleele i matu, ma amata ona fai mo i latou laueleele uma ia sa tuua e sa Nifaē, ma aai ia sa tuufua.

w.en: and they began to come down
and began to take for themselves
and began to take for themselves

verses.en: But behold, there were no wild beasts nor game in those lands which had been deserted by the Nephites, and there was no game for the robbers save it were in the wilderness.
verses.sm: Ae faauta, sa leai ni manu aivao po o se manu aina i ia laueleele na tuua e sa Nifaē, ma sa leai se manu aina mo faomea vagana ai lava i le vao.

verses.en: And the robbers could not exist save it were in the wilderness, for the want of food; for the Nephites had left their lands desolate, and had gathered their flocks and their herds and all their substance, and they were in one body.
verses.sm: Ma sa le mafai e faomea ona ola vagana i le vao, ona sa manaomia meaai; ona sa tuufua e sa Nifaē o latou laueleele, ma sa faapotopoto a latou lafu ma a latou fagaga ma a latou mea uma, ma ua tasi i latou i la le tino.

w.en: And the robbers could not live

verses.en: Therefore, there was no chance for the robbers to plunder and to obtain food, save it were to come up in open battle against the Nephites; and the Nephites being in one body, and having so great a number, and having reserved for themselves provisions, and horses and cattle, and flocks of every kind, that they might subsist for the space of seven years, in the which time they did hope to destroy the robbers from off the face of the land; and thus the eighteenth year did pass away.
verses.sm: O lea, sa leai se avanoa mo faomea latou te vete ma maua ai ni meaai, vagana ai ua latou o a’e e tau faafesagai ma sa Nifaē; ma o sa Nifaē, ona ua tasi i latou i la le tino, ma sa matuā toatele lava lo latou aofai, ma sa latou teuina mo i latou lava o mea e manaomia, ma solofanua ma povi, ma lafu o ituaiga eseese, ina ia mafai ona latou ola mo le va o le fitu tausaga, o le taimi lea sa latou faamoemoe e faaumatia ai le au faomea mai luga o le laueleele; ma sa faapea ona mavae atu o le tausaga e sefulu ma le valu.

verses.en: And it came to pass that in the nineteenth year Giddianhi found that it was expedient that he should go up to battle against the Nephites, for there was no way that they could subsist save it were to plunder and rob and murder.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo i le tausaga e sefuluiva, sa iloa e Kitianae e tatau ona ia alu ae e tau faasaga ia sa Nifaē, ona sa leai se ala e mafai ona latou ola ai vagana ai le vete ma le gaoi ma le fasioti tagata.

verses.en: And they durst not spread themselves upon the face of the land insomuch that they could raise grain, lest the Nephites should come upon them and slay them; therefore Giddianhi gave commandment unto his armies that in this year they should go up to battle against the Nephites.
verses.sm: Ma sa latou fefefe e faasalalau atu i latou lava i luga o le laueleele seia oo ina mafai ona latou toto o saito, nei o mai sa Nifaē i o latou luga ma fasioti i latou; o lea na faatonu atu ai Kitianae i ana autau e faapea o le tausaga lenei e tatau ona latou o a’e ai e tau faasaga ia sa Nifaē.

verses.en: And it came to pass that they did come up to battle; and it was in the sixth month; and behold, great and terrible was the day that they did come up to battle; and they were girded about after the manner of robbers; and they had a lamb– skin about their loins, and they were dyed in blood, and their heads were shorn, and they had head– plates upon them; and great and terrible was the appearance of the armies of Giddianhi, because of their armor, and because of their being dyed in blood.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina latou o ae e tau; ma o le masina lea lona ono; ma faauta, o se aso tele ma le matautia lea na latou o ae ai e tau; ma sa latou oofu e tusa ma aga a tagata faomea; ma sa latou fusi se pa’u-mamoe i o latou sulugatiti, ma sa sausau ia fusi i le toto, ma sa sele mama o latou ulu, ma sa latou tuu ai i luga ni puloutau; ma sa uiga ese ma matautia le foliga mai o autau a Kitianae, ona o o latou ofutau, ma ona o le sausauina o i latou i le toto.

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: And it came to pass that the armies of the Nephites, when they saw the appearance of the army of Giddianhi, had all fallen to the earth, and did lift their cries to the Lord their God, that he would spare them and deliver them out of the hands of their enemies.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina ua vaai atu autau a sa Nifaē, i le foliga mai o le autau a Kitianae, sa pa’u’ū uma ifo i le eleele, ma sii ae a latou tagi i le Alii lo latou Atua, ia ona faasaoina i latou ma laveai i latou mai lima o o latou fili.

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: And it came to pass that when the armies of Giddianhi saw this they began to shout with a loud voice, because of their joy, for they had supposed that the Nephites had fallen with fear because of the terror of their armies.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina ua vaai mai le autau a Kitianae i lenei mea sa amata ona latou alalaga ma le leo tetele, ona o lo latou olioli, ona sa latou manatu ua pa’u’ū ifo sa Nifaē i le eleele ona o le fefefe i le matautia o a latou autau.

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: But in this thing they were disappointed, for the Nephites did not fear them; but they did fear their God and did supplicate him for protection; therefore, when the armies of Giddianhi did rush  upon them they were prepared to meet them; yea, in the strength of the Lord they did receive them.
verses.sm: Peitai sa latou faanoanoa i lenei mea, ona sa le fefefe sa Nifaē ia te i latou; ae sa latou matatau i lo latou Atua ma latou faatoga atu ia te ia mo le puipuiga; o lea, ina ua osofai mai autau a Kitianae i luga o i latou sa saunia e faafetaiai i latou; ioe, sa latou faafetaiai i latou i le malosi o le Alii.

verses.en: And the battle commenced in this the sixth month; and great and terrible was the battle thereof, yea, great and terrible was the slaughter thereof, insomuch that there never was known so great a slaughter among all the people of Lehi since he left Jerusalem.
verses.sm: Ma sa amataina le taua i le masina lona ono lenei; ma sa uiga ese ma matautia le taua na faia ai, ioe, sa tele ma matautia le fasiga na faia ai, sa oo ina sa lei iloa lava se fasiga tele faapea sa i ai i totonu o tagata uma o Liae talu mai ona ia tuua Ierusalema.

w.en: among all the people of Lehi

verses.en: And notwithstanding the threatenings and the oaths which Giddianhi had made, behold, the Nephites did beat them, insomuch that they did fall back from before them.
verses.sm: Ma e ui i faamata’u ma tautoga ia na faia e Kitianae, faauta, sa faatoilaloina i latou e sa Nifaē, sa oo ina latou solomuli mai o latou luma.

verses.en: And it came to pass that Gidgiddoni commanded that his armies should pursue them as far as the borders of the wilderness, and that they should not spare any that should fall into their hands by the way; and thus they did pursue them and did slay them, to the borders of the wilderness, even until they had fulfilled the commandment of Gidgiddoni.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina faatonu e Kitekitonae ana autau ia latou tutulia i latou ia oo atu le mamao i tuaoi o le vao, ma ia aua nei o latou faasaoina soo se tasi o i latou e pa’ū mai i o latou lima i le ala; ma sa faapea ona latou tuliloa o i latou ma fasiotia, e oo atu i tuaoi o le vao, seia oo lava ina latou faataunuuina le poloaiga a Kitekitonae.

w.en: And it came to pass that
to the borders of the wilderness,

verses.en: And it came to pass that Giddianhi, who had stood and fought with boldness, was pursued as he fled; and being weary because of his much fighting he was overtaken and slain. And thus was the end of Giddianhi the robber.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina sa tuliloaina Kitianae, o le sa tulai ma tau ma le toa, a o sola; ma ona o le vaivai ona o lona tau ua tele naua, sa maua atu ai o ia ma fasiotia. Ma sa faapea le iuga o Kitianae le faomea.

w.en: And it came to pass that
And thus was the end of

verses.en: And it came to pass that the armies of the Nephites did return again to their place of security. And it came to pass that this nineteenth year did pass away, and the robbers did not come again to battle; neither did they come again in the twentieth year.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina toe foi mai autau a sa Nifaē i lo latou nofoaga malu. Ma sa oo ina mavae atu lenei tausaga e sefulu ma le iva, ma sa le toe o mai le au faomea e tau; ma sa latou le toe o mai foi i le tausaga e luasefulu.

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: And in the twenty and first year they did not come up to battle, but they came up on all sides to lay siege round about the people of Nephi; for they did suppose that if they should cut off the people of Nephi from their lands, and should hem them in on every side, and if they should cut them off from all their outward privileges, that they could cause them to yield themselves up according to their wishes.
verses.sm: Ma i le tausaga e luasefulu ma le tasi sa latou le o a’e e tau, ae sa latou o a’e i itu uma e si’o faamalosi le nuu o Nifae; ona sa latou manatu afai latou te momotu ese le nuu o Nifae mai o latou laueleele, ma pupuni i latou i totonu i itu uma, ma afai latou te si’o ese i latou mai o latou avanoa uma i fafo, o le a mafai ona latou faamalosia i latou ia latou tuu atu i latou lava e tusa ma o latou manao.

w.en: and if they cut them off

verses.en: Now they had appointed unto themselves another leader, whose name was Zemnarihah; therefore it was Zemnarihah that did cause that this siege should take place.
verses.sm: O lenei sa latou tofia mo i latou se tasi taitai, o lona igoa o Seminaraea; o lea, o Seminaraea lenei na ia faatonuina le faia o lenei si’o faamalosi.

verses.en: But behold, this was an advantage to the Nephites; for it was impossible for the robbers to lay siege sufficiently long to have any effect upon the Nephites, because of their much provision which they had laid up in store,
verses.sm: Ae faauta, o se mea lelei lenei ia sa Nifaē; ona sa le mafai e le au faomea ona faia se si’o faamalosi e lava le umi e oo ai se afaina i luga o tagata sa Nifaē, ona sa tele a latou sauniuniga ia na latou teuina,

verses.en: And because of the scantiness of provisions among the robbers—for behold, they had nothing save it were meat for their subsistence, which meat they did obtain in the wilderness;
verses.sm: Ma ona o le utiuti o mea manaomia sa i ai mo le au faomea; aua faauta, sa leai ni mea sa ia i latou vagana ai aano o manu sa latou ola ai, o aano ia o manu sa latou maua i le vao.

verses.en: And it came to pass that the wild game became scarce in the wilderness—insomuch that the robbers were about to perish with hunger.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina tau le maua ni manu aina aivao sa oo ina toetoe a fano le au faomea i le fia aai.

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: And the Nephites were continually marching out by day and by night, and falling upon their armies, and cutting them off by thousands and by tens of thousands.
verses.sm: Ma sa faaauau pea ona savavali atu sa Nifaē i le ao ma le po, ma osofai i a latou autau, ma fasiotia i latou i le taiafe ma le taisefulu o afe.

verses.en: And thus it became the desire of the people of Zemnarihah to withdraw from their design, because of the great destruction which came upon them by night and by day.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina mananao tagata o Seminaraea ia solomuli ese mai la latou fuafuaga, ona o le faaumatiaga tele lea na oo mai i luga o i latou i le po ma le ao.

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: And it came to pass that Zemnarihah did give command unto his people that they should withdraw themselves from the siege, and march into the furthermost parts of the land northward.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina faatonu atu Seminaraea i ona tagata e tatau ona latou solomuli ese i latou lava mai le sio faamalosi, ma savavali atu i vaega aupito mamao o le laueleele i matu.

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: And now, Gidgiddoni being aware of their design, and knowing of their weakness because of the want of food, and the great slaughter which had been made among them, therefore he did send out his armies in the night– time, and did cut off the way of their retreat, and did place his armies in the way of their retreat.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei, ina ua iloa e Kitekitonae la latou fuafuaga, ma i lona iloa o lo latou vaivai ona o lo latou fia aai, ma le faasauaga tele lea na faia i totonu ia te i latou, o lea na ia auina atu ai ana autau i le po, ma vavae ese le ala o la latou solaaga, ma tuu ana autau i le ala o la latou solaaga.

w.en: in the way of their retreat.

verses.en: And this did they do in the night– time, and got on their march beyond the robbers, so that on the morrow, when the robbers began their march, they were met by the armies of the Nephites both in their front and in their rear.
verses.sm: Ma sa latou faia lenei mea i le po, ma alu la latou savaliga i luma atu o le au faomea, e amata atu le savaliga a le au faomea i le aso na sosoo ai, ae faafetaiai mai i latou e autau a sa Nifaē i o latou luma ma o latou tua.

w.en: by the armies of the Nephites

verses.en: And the robbers who were on the south were also cut off in their places of retreat. And all these things were done by command of Gidgiddoni.
verses.sm: Ma o le au faomea o e sa i le itu i saute sa sisio ese foi mai o latou nofoaga na solomuli atu i ai. Ma o nei mea uma sa faia i le faatonuga a Kitekitonae.

verses.en: And there were many thousands who did yield themselves up prisoners unto the Nephites, and the remainder of them were slain.
verses.sm: Ma sa i ai le tele o afe o e na latou tuuina mai i latou lava ia sa Nifaē o ni pagota, ma o e na totoe o i latou na fasiotia.

verses.en: And their leader, Zemnarihah, was taken and hanged upon a tree, yea, even upon the top thereof until he was dead. And when they had hanged him until he was dead they did fell the tree to the earth, and did cry with a loud voice, saying:
verses.sm: Ma o lo latou taitai, o Seminaraea, sa aveina ma sisi i luga o se laau, ioe, i luga lava o lona tumutumu seia oo ina oti o ia. Ma ina ua uma ona latou sisi o ia seia oo ina oti ai, sa latou taina i lalo le laau i le eleele, ma alalaga ma le leo tetele, fai mai:

w.en: And when they had hanged him

verses.en: May the Lord preserve his people in righteousness and in holiness of heart, that they may cause to be felled to the earth all who shall seek to slay them because of power and secret combinations, even as this man hath been felled to the earth.
verses.sm: Tau ina ia faasaoina e le Alii lona nuu i le amiotonu ma le paia o le loto, ina ia mafai ona latou faapa’u’ūina i le eleele i latou uma o e e saili e fasioti i latou ona o le pule ma faapotopotoga faalilolilo, e pei lava ona faapa’ū o lenei tagata i le eleele.

verses.en: And they did rejoice and cry again with one voice, saying: May the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, protect this people in righteousness, so long as they shall call on the name of their God for protection.
verses.sm: Ma sa latou olioli ma toe alalaga ma le leo e tasi, e faapea: Tau ina ia puipuia e le Atua o Aperaamo, ma le Atua o Isaako, ma le Atua o Iakopo, lenei nuu i le amiotonu, pe a latou valaau atu pea i le suafa o lo latou Atua mo le puipuiga.

w.en: on the name of their God

verses.en: And it came to pass that they did break forth, all as one, in singing, and praising their God for the great thing which he had done for them, in preserving them from falling into the hands of their enemies.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina latou alalaga atu, tagata uma i se leo e tasi, i pesega, ma viiga o lo latou Atua mo le mea sili ua ia faia mo i latou, i le faasaoina o i latou mai le pa’u’ū atu i lima o o latou fili.

w.en: And it came to pass that
into the hands of their enemies.

verses.en: Yea, they did cry: Hosanna to the Most High God. And they did cry: Blessed be the name of the Lord God Almighty, the Most High God.
verses.sm: Ioe, sa latou alalaga atu: Osana i le Atua Silisili Ese. Ma sa latou alalaga atu: Ia faamanuina le suafa o le Alii le Atua Malosi Aoao, o le Atua Silisili Ese.

verses.en: And their hearts were swollen with joy, unto the gushing out of many tears, because of the  great goodness of God in delivering them out of the hands of their enemies; and they knew it was because of their repentance and their humility that they had been delivered from an everlasting destruction.
verses.sm: Ma sa faatumuina o latou loto i le olioli, seia oo lava i le maligi ifo o loimata e tele, ona o le agalelei tele o le Atua i le laveaiina o i latou mai lima o o latou fili; ma sa latou iloa o lo latou salamo ma lo latou lotomaualalalo ua laveaiina ai i latou mai se faafanoga faavavau.
